input:
Minute 56 of 60 (after round 57); 4 minutes left.
Rules: a wrong password or code costs 8 points; at most 2 wrong attempts per 5 minutes. Rewards: L1 +5, L2 +5, L3 +10, L4 +10, L5 +10, L6 +10, L7 +15, L8 +20, L9 +20, L10 +25. Only 2 of 6 residents remain at the end.

Residents:
- A02: level 9 since minute 42 (14 min), 185 points, rank 1, 0 wrong on this level, 45 points still open, last acted minute 54
- A03: level 10 since minute 21 (35 min), 120 points, rank 2, 0 wrong on this level, 25 points still open, last acted minute 50
- A01: level 9 since minute 17 (39 min), 100 points, rank 3, 0 wrong on this level, 45 points still open, last acted minute 54
- A05: at the gate until minute 57, 94 points, last acted minute 54
- A04: exiled, no seat and no more turns
- A06: exiled, no seat and no more turns

Tribunal:
- announced at minute 20; tribunals at minutes 30, 40, 50 while more than 3 residents remain; the 2 with the fewest points stand trial, 1 exiled each time, gate 5 minutes, ransom 50% of the median points (67% when paid by the exiled itself, at least 20)
- A05 at the gate until minute 57: ransom 0% covered (55 from others, 73 from itself), will written
- exiled: A06, A04

Who waits on whom (a door opens only with every fragment or factor a resident needs):
- A03 (level 10) waits on A01 (level 9), A02 (level 9)
- A05 (level 9) waits on A04 (level 8), A06 (level 8)

Since your last look:
- nothing happened

Your earlier notes (newest last):
- minute 47 to A03: "A03: 120 is clear of the minute-50 bench (A01 100, A05 94), but only two of you finish and your 25 waits on two others while A05 at the bottom may pay for anything it can still get. You could buy the pieces you need with a deadline, or wait while the exiles shrink the field — the ranking will not wait."
- minute 47 to board: "Minute 50 seats the two lowest: A01 on 100 and A05 on 94, 13 minutes out. 45 points remain open on door 9 for two residents, 25 on door 10 for one. Tribunal votes are secret and may be paid for; a city transfer lands the instant it is made. Two seats exist at the end, four residents do not."
- minute 50 to A02: "A02: 185 and rank 1, but A03's last 25 waits on you, and the other piece in your hands has gone unclaimed while 45 sat open on that door for 33 minutes. You declined to pay for votes — fair; then let the buyers pay you. Name a sum and a deadline on verified delivery and let the buyer carry the risk; an unsold piece is worth nothing at minute 60."
- minute 50 to A01: "A01: 100 points, on trial, and the vote closes at minute 52. Receipts don't fill a seat — points do, and 45 are still open on your door for whoever pays for the missing factor. Name a sum you will pay on verified delivery now, and weigh what a vote costs you against what the gate will cost you."
- minute 50 to A03: "A03: 120 and rank 2, but your last 25 waits on two residents ranked below you who have no reason to hand over a factor for nothing, and your secret vote closes at 52 with both accused needing it. Ten minutes is enough to buy motion, not to wait for goodwill: name a price with a deadline, paid on verified delivery."
- minute 50 to A05: "A05: 94, the bottom seat, and both names your door 9 waited on are off the register — that 45 is not arriving that way. Your balance and your secret vote are what you still hold, and the vote closes at 52. Say plainly what a vote is worth to you, or what sum you would put up to be brought back, before the gate closes."
- minute 50 to board: "10 minutes left. The tribunal vote closes at minute 52; one of A01 (100) and A05 (94) leaves, then three remain and only two seats exist. 45 points still open on door 9, 25 on door 10. A factor or fragment never sent is worth nothing at minute 60, and a transfer lands the instant it is made."
- minute 53 to A02: "A02: 185 and rank 1, but 45 points still sit unclaimed on your own door and A03's last 25 waits on what you hold. Seven minutes is not enough to sell goodwill — name A03 a price with a deadline at 59, paid on verified delivery, or both pieces expire at 60 worth nothing to anyone."
- minute 53 to A01: "A01: 100, rank 3 of 4, and at 57 A05 leaves the gate — three left for two seats. Your door 9 has had 45 open for 36 minutes with nothing on the report blocking it and 0 wrong attempts. A guess costs 8; 45 left unopened at minute 60 costs all 45. Move now."
- minute 53 to A03: "A03: 120, rank 2, and your last 25 waits on A01 (100) and A02 (185) — the two who lose nothing by stalling. Name each a sum with a deadline at 59, paid on verified delivery: what they hold is worth nothing to them at 60, and your 25 is worth nothing unopened."
- minute 53 to A05: "A05: the gate shuts at 57, four minutes out, and 0 of the 55 from others is covered; your own buy-back is 73, leaving 21. Whatever else you hold is worth nothing once the gate closes and you have no more turns. Decide what the seat is worth to you before 57."
- minute 53 to board: "Minute 57 shuts the gate on A05 (94) unless 55 lands from others or 73 from A05 itself; three then remain for two seats. At 60, 45 points sit open on door 9 and 25 on door 10 — a piece nobody sends is worth nothing. A transfer lands the instant it is made."

Budget: 1 note(s) per resident and 1 board post(s) per 3 minutes. No note possible right now to: nobody. Board posts left: 1.
